page_title: MON 0-1 LYO | Monaco v Lyon 15/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Henrique (Lyon) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
90+4' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
90+2' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
89' Great touch by Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
88' Here is a change. Ismail Jakobs is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
88' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Krepin Diatta (Monaco), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
85' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Ainsley Maitland-Niles plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Jeffinho (Lyon). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
83' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeffinho (Lyon) replacing Ernest Nuamah.
83' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Tino Kadewere.
82' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
82' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
79' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
78' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Maghnes Akliouche will be replaced by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco).
77' A dangerous towering header by Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
77' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
77' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender.
75' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' Pierre Sage is forced to make a change. Nicolas Tagliafico is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Henrique (Lyon).
73' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) comes onto the pitch so that Corentin Tolisso can be given a rest.
71' Here comes a substitution. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is given a rest as he is replaced by Mahamadou Diawara.
70' Mohamed Camara is substituted due to injury. Adi Hutter gives a chance to Edan Diop (Monaco).
69' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
68' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

68' Anthony Lopes makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
65' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
62' A cross from Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
61' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
58' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the left post.
58' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Takumi Minamino (Monaco). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
56' A long pass finds Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn reacts well to make a good save.
55' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
55' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
52' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) takes the corner with a short pass.
52' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
51' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) works the corner short.
50' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.

48' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
46' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
46' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
44' 6:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
43' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
42' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

41' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes was alert and the score remains the same. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
38' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Folarin Balogun (Monaco) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
38' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

37' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top left corner, but Anthony Lopes was alert and the score remains the same. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
31' What was Clinton Mata (Lyon) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
31' Clinton Mata (Lyon) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar.
29' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ruddy Buquet had an easy-decision to make.
27' The linesman signals that Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' A lofted cross from Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
22' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) brings an opponent down and Ruddy Buquet interrupts the game.
21' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to find Folarin Balogun, but he puts too much power on the pass.
19' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
18' It seemed like Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
18' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ernest Nuamah.
16' The Monaco players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
14' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

13' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Anthony Lopes was alert and the score remains the same.
12' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
10' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and signals a foul after Denis Zakaria (Monaco) brought his opponent down. Lyon are awarded the free kick.
9' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
7' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
6' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' A pass by Mohamed Camara (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) trips an opposition player and Ruddy Buquet signals a foul.
2' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
